description: ITALY. Computes the national purchase taxes: registration tax 9% (2% with prima casa relief, min. €1,000) on the price or the cadastral value (prezzo-valore) plus €50 + €50 on a resale from a private owner; VAT 10% (4% prima casa, 22% luxury A/1, A/8, A/9) plus €200 × 3 on a new build from a builder; optional substitute tax on the mortgage (0.25% / 2%) and an agent commission the user gives. The notary fee is never computed (no tariff).

agent_commission_pct.description: Agent commission the buyer pays, % of the price (optional; no legal rate exists).

cadastral_income.description: Rendita catastale in euros, to tax the cadastral value instead of the price (private seller only, optional).

first_home.description: Prima casa relief (main home, conditions apply).

luxury_category.description: Cadastral category A/1, A/8 or A/9 (excluded from the relief).

seller.description: "private" (resale, default) or "builder" (new build sold with VAT).

title: Italian purchase taxes on a home
